title: A Passage for the Horizon
premise: Desert ranger Ansel Nakamura chases a thief across the salt flats and into a sea cave revealed by an impossible tide, where they stumble upon a stranded expedition guarding a discovery that could redraw every border on the map. Bound by a debt to the expedition's dying leader, Ansel must guide the survivors home through a storm while deciding whether loyalty means keeping their secret or telling the truth that could save a drowned village downstream. When the thief resurfaces as the expedition's betrayer, Ansel chooses truth over silence, exposing the find and finding, at last, a place to belong.
about_author: Ulyana Voss is the pen name of a former field cartographer who spent six years mapping coastlines that no longer exist. They write adventure stories about people who carry too much and own too little.

chapters.title: The Debt in the Salt
chapters.summary: Ansel's POV. Tracking thief Wren Corvane across the flats, Ansel loses them at the tide line just as the water retreats impossibly far, revealing a cave mouth carved with old warnings. Inside, they find a wrecked expedition, its leader Halvard bleeding out, whispering a debt Ansel's father owed him. The beat: reluctant obligation replacing the chase.

chapters.title: What the Cave Kept
chapters.summary: Ansel's POV, shifting to expedition survivor Ilsa's midway through. The cave holds a buried vessel and charts proving the desert was once a sea route — knowledge worth killing for. Wren is revealed among the survivors, having infiltrated the expedition. Storm seals the entrance; the tide won't return for days. The beat: dread and uneasy alliance.

chapters.title: Carry the Dying Light
chapters.summary: Ilsa's POV. With Halvard failing, Ansel leads the group through flooded inner passages toward a second exit, Wren sabotaging supplies and stealing the charts. In the climax, Ansel corners Wren at the exit and must choose: kill the thief and keep the secret, or let them go and tell the world. Ansel lets the truth loose. The beat: sacrifice of silence.

chapters.title: A Passage for the Horizon
chapters.summary: Ansel's POV. The survivors emerge into the storm's aftermath; Halvard dies naming Ansel his heir to the debt — now paid in truth. The charts go public, the drowned village is evacuated in time, and Ilsa offers Ansel a place on the next expedition. Ansel finally sets down the compass. The beat: belonging earned, not inherited.
